# Port Helios cargo terminal

Port Helios is a fictional cargo terminal used only for CyClaw evaluation. Its
maximum daily cargo capacity is 18,000 metric tons. Routine cargo inspections
begin at 06:00 local time every Monday and Thursday. The terminal operates four
battery-electric cranes, and the crane conversion reduced annual diesel use by
40 percent. A separate cold-storage building can hold 9,000 pallets. The rail
spur handles 22 freight wagons per shift. Hazardous cargo is staged in Bay 7,
which is inspected twice per shift. These facts describe the evaluation
fixture, not a real port or operator facility. The corpus does not state the
terminal's annual revenue or name its harbourmaster.
